sections.advice: Knysna → Avontuur is 45 km of rhythm rather than effort. Let it flow and let the view breathe.
Avontuur → Prince Alfreds Pass climbs about 1040 m in 6 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Prince Alfreds Pass → Uniondale drops about 1040 m over 5 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.

scenicChapters.title: Prince Alfreds Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: The valley floor is behind you and the road starts working for its height at about 16.3%. Corners stack above one another where the ground allows nothing straighter — first and second gear more often than not. Look through each corner to the next one and let the engine do the holding.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Prince Alfreds Pass
scenicChapters.narrative: 1040 m come off over 7 km at around 19.5%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

prince-alfreds-pass.story: Out of Knysna, one way: 75 km, roughly 1 h 15 in the saddle. It goes by way of Avontuur and Prince Alfreds Pass. The highest point is about 1,050 m. It suits an unhurried touring pace.
